platform_mcp_applovin_campaign_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLOVIN_CAMPAIGN_API_KEY
platform_mcp_applovin_campaign_api_key.description: Campaign Management API key (AppLovin dashboard > your account, top right > Keys; not the Ad Unit Management key), sent as the raw `Authorization` header value on api.ads.axon.ai.

platform_mcp_applovin_report_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLOVIN_REPORT_KEY
platform_mcp_applovin_report_key.description: Report Key (dashboard > account > Keys), sent as the api_key query parameter of GET https://r.applovin.com/report; needed only for get_report.

platform_mcp_applovin_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLOVIN_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_applovin_account_id.description: Numeric AppLovin account id (dashboard > account > Go to settings: the number after the account name); every Campaign Management call carries it as ?account_id=.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /campaign/list?account_id=…&size=1, which verifies the Campaign Management key against the configured account.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /campaign/list?account_id=…&page=…&size=… (a JSON array of Campaign objects, at most 100 per page). status is LIVE or PAUSED. `budget` is the global daily budget (a decimal string); campaigns with per-country budgets have it in raw.budget.country_code_to_daily_budget. `status` is not sent (no status filter is documented).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET https://r.applovin.com/report?api_key=<Report Key>&start&end&columns=day,campaign,campaign_id_external,impressions,clicks,conversions,cost&format=json&report_type=advertiser (UTC; the request window is the last 45 days). Rows are read from `results`. `account_id` is not sent (the Report Key selects the account) and `campaign_id` is not applied: the report identifies campaigns by campaign_id_external (the campaign's hashed_id), not the numeric id list_campaigns returns.

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /campaign/update?account_id=… {id, type: APP, budget: {daily_budget_for_all_countries}} sets one uniform daily budget (account currency, USD) across all targeted countries; this spends money and replaces any per-country budgets. `currency` is ignored.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /campaign/update?account_id=… {id, type: APP, status: PAUSED|LIVE} (pause → PAUSED, resume → LIVE). Resuming restarts spend.
